senses.gloss:
Koraṇṭa(nda)ka
Siddha mentioned in Svātmārāma's Haṭhayogapradīpikā (I. 6) an. Haṭharatnāvalī of Śrīnivāsa (TD. 6715).

Koravañji
drama after the Tamil musical play of that name. by Śrīnivāsaguru. a. ancestor of Veṅkaṭavarada of Vīravalli family; mentioned in the latter's Kṛṣṇavijaya, MD. 12744.

Korilāmāhātmya
paur. from Narmadākhaṇḍa. Ujjain II. p. 22.

Korukoṇḍakṣetramāhātmya
or tuGgazailamAhAtmya paur. in 4 chs. assigned to Skandapurāṇa; on Korukoṇḍa, a hill eleven miles from Rajahmundry where there is a shrine to Nṛsiṁha. C.. Korukoṇḍa Kaifiat.
IO. 3654. Mack. 72.
Pt.. Āndhra Sārasvata Niketan, Rajahmundry, 1915.

Korrapāda(du)teluṅgārya
father of Rāmānuja an. grandfather of Lakṣmaṇakavi (a. of Kṛṣṇavilāsa, MD. 12228).
